intended_object: This is the syntactic "blueprint" for defining negation on coded formulas by structural recursion inside a model of IΣ₁. It is a bundle of Σ₁-formulas, one for each recursion case, used to prove that the recursively defined function `L.neg` is Σ₁-definable. I inferred this from the body, the namespace `Negation`, and its use in `Negation.construction`, `Language.neg` and `LDef.negDef`.
